operations.name: heal.brush_stroke
operations.description: Healing Brush: alt-source clone that transplants source texture while matching destination luminosity/color. source_x/source_y set the source; points is flat [x1,y1,...] doc coordinates.

source_x.description: Sampled source doc x; required when source=sampled

source_y.description: Sampled source doc y; required when source=sampled

source.description: sampled or pattern (default current option or sampled)

blend_mode.description: Healing blend mode (default current healing-brush mode or normal)

pattern_id.description: Pattern preset id when source=pattern; defaults to active pattern

aligned.description: Keep the source offset aligned across strokes (default current option or true)

operations.name: heal.patch
operations.description: Patch tool: fill a selected region from an offset source with edge color/luminosity matching. Uses the current selection, or a polygon in points; dx/dy are the drag offset.

dx.description: Drag offset x in doc px

dy.description: Drag offset y in doc px

mode.description: source repairs the selected destination from offset source; destination copies selected source to offset destination

patch.description: normal copy or content-aware texture/color match

sample_all_layers.description: Sample the flattened composite instead of only the active layer

points.description: Optional flat polygon [x1,y1,x2,y2,...] used instead of current selection

operations.name: heal.red_eye
operations.description: Red Eye tool: detect a red-dominant elliptical pupil region around (x,y), then desaturate and darken it. Respects the current selection when present.

pupil_size.description: Approximate maximum pupil diameter in px (default current option or 28)

operations.name: heal.spot_stroke
operations.description: Spot Healing Brush: repair blemishes through points by sampling texture from a ring around each stamp and matching surrounding low-frequency color. points is flat [x1,y1,...] in doc coordinates.

blend_mode.description: Healing blend mode (default current spot-heal mode or normal)

sample_all_layers.description: Sample the flattened composite instead of only the active layer
